independence_and_eligibility.finding: All 42 exact candidate molecules are molecule- and structure-independent of the evaluated Phase17/18/20 panels under the available ID, canonical/isomeric, achiral, and achiral Murcko checks. This establishes dataset independence under those checks, not independence from Boltz pretraining.

fixed_split_check.seed_rule: SHA256(cryo-phase19-split-1900: + achiral Murcko scaffold), whole scaffold groups assigned to calibration until ceil(42/3)=14 is reached
fixed_split_check.finding: The fixed seed yields the stated provisional 27/15 split and 3/15 scaffold allocation. Every test scaffold is unseen among prior evaluated scaffolds, and no test scaffold exceeds 40% of test rows.

diversity_cautions.calibration_concentration: The 27 calibration rows occupy only 3 Murcko scaffolds; one scaffold contains 25/27 rows (92.6%). This is a highly concentrated calibration set and makes a calibration offset vulnerable to the dominant chemical series.
diversity_cautions.test_distribution: The 15 test rows are 15 singleton Murcko scaffolds. This meets the scaffold-count rule, but each test scaffold has one observation, so scaffold-level uncertainty cannot be estimated within a scaffold.

murcko_artifact_check.interpretation: Generic Murcko reduction still gives 11 test core classes, but it is not a validated measure of pharmacophore independence. Several singleton Murcko groups can differ mainly by pendant-ring or side-chain topology, while chemically meaningful substitutions may be collapsed into one core. Report both the fixed Murcko result and this limitation; do not describe 15 singleton scaffolds as 15 independent mechanisms.

diversity_cautions.method: Counts were recomputed from the ChEMBL raw JSON with RDKit achiral Bemis-Murcko scaffolds and the frozen Phase19 split hash rule. No alternate seed or potency-based split was searched.

primary_method_validity.article_method: The 2013 primary article reports a Cisbio STK2 HTRF ROCK-I/II assay: 5 uL substrate/ATP mixture plus 5 uL enzyme, 4 h at room temperature, stop with antibody/Sa-XL, 1 h detection, ViewLux HTRF.
primary_method_validity.construct_evidence: The article/SI identifies ROCK-II 1-543 as cloned and purified as described earlier; the cited Schröter primary protocol supports recombinant human 6-His ROCK-II residues 1-543. This is method-transfer evidence, not an independent 2013 lot or sequence certificate.
primary_method_validity.assay_identity_limit: The ChEMBL assay description itself says ROCK2 origin is unknown. Linking all 42 ChEMBL rows to the article's human ROCK-II 1-543 preparation therefore remains source-document linkage rather than direct ChEMBL construct metadata. A run should retain this historical certainty limit and must not pool the urea panel with other ROCK2 assay formats.

decision.independent_scaffold_test: conditionally_viable: 15 unseen singleton test scaffolds, with limited within-scaffold uncertainty
decision.recommended_reporting: Report molecule independence, unseen test Murcko scaffolds, 27/15 imbalance, dominant 25-row calibration scaffold, and pendant-ring/core ambiguity together. Do not retune the seed or claim broad chemical-domain validation from this panel alone.
